n50edc53df1.headline: Africa needs a new Marshall Plan, says AfDB presidential candidate
n50edc53df1.summary: Samuel Maimbo, one of eight candidates to succeed Akinwumi Adesina at the African Development Bank, said the continent needs a new Marshall Plan. He said Africa must focus on economic results.
n50edc53df1.why: The African Development Bank is a multilateral lender financing infrastructure and development projects across Africa, so its leadership shapes that lending.

nf8e5d078bd.headline: Analysis-German conservatives' vote with far right set to complicate coalition building
nf8e5d078bd.summary: Mainstream conservatives' cooperation with the far right broke a taboo and looks set to complicate coalition building after next month's election. The analysis says it could deepen divisions.
nf8e5d078bd.why: Coalition arithmetic determines Germany's fiscal and economic policy, which influences German bond yields and the euro.

n138db1c1cb.headline: Political parties reject Eskom 12.7% electricity tariff hike
n138db1c1cb.summary: Political parties have rejected Eskom's 12.7% electricity tariff increase. The EFF says the hike is an assault on the poor and the working class.
n138db1c1cb.why: Eskom is South Africa's state-owned electricity utility, and its tariffs feed into household costs, business input costs and the country's inflation outlook.

na74449c146.headline: Ukraine’s Oldest Cryptocurrency Exchange KUNA Shuts Down After Court Ban
na74449c146.summary: Kuna, Ukraine's oldest cryptocurrency exchange, has shut down after a court ban. Law enforcement suspects the platform of tax evasion, and its founder said he is not willing to fight further.
na74449c146.why: Cryptocurrency exchanges are platforms where digital assets are bought and sold, and regulatory or legal actions against them affect local market access and liquidity.

n94b485a5e8.headline: January 31: Sensex, Nifty surge as markets cheer Economic Survey ahead of Budget
n94b485a5e8.summary: Indian benchmark indices extended gains for a fourth straight day as Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman presented the Economic Survey 2024-25 in Parliament. The survey came ahead of the Union Budget 2025-26.
n94b485a5e8.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty 50 are India's main benchmark equity indices, tracking large listed companies and serving as barometers of domestic market sentiment.
n94b485a5e8.why_moved: Investors reacted positively to the Economic Survey 2024-25 presented in Parliament ahead of the Union Budget 2025-26, extending a four-day rally.

n2013b34cf5.headline: USD/JPY Price Analysis: Dollar Rebounds as US Tariffs Loom
n2013b34cf5.summary: The USD/JPY analysis indicates a growing likelihood of a 25% US tariff on goods from Mexico and Canada, which is supporting the dollar against the yen.
n2013b34cf5.why: Tariffs on major trading partners affect trade flows, inflation expectations and currency markets, which are central to macro investing.
n2013b34cf5.why_moved: The article links the dollar's rebound to the increasing likelihood of 25% US tariffs on Mexican and Canadian goods.

n650e500086.headline: Gold at record high, majors quiet ahead of inflation data
n650e500086.summary: Gold rose more than 1% on Thursday and traded at an all-time peak near $2,800, as investors sought safety after Donald Trump's continued tariff threats. Major currency pairs traded in narrow ranges ahead of inflation data.
n650e500086.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset, and its price tends to rise when trade tensions and inflation concerns increase demand for protection.

n0c424194ae.why: The Athens General Composite index tracks Greece's listed companies, and its performance reflects Greek banks and the country's economic recovery.

n7d62e7428e.summary: The Bank of Italy notified Banco di Desio e della Brianza that it has confirmed the group's 2024 capital requirements. The primary Tier 1 capital ratio remains at 7.60 percent.

n032a6afd87.headline: Businesses, shoppers brace for higher prices if tariffs on Mexico and Canada imports start Saturday
n032a6afd87.summary: President Trump renewed a threat to impose 25% tariffs on imports from Mexico and Canada as early as this weekend. Businesses and shoppers are bracing for higher prices on goods including gasoline.

nea00f1a892.why: Tariff threats on BRICS countries could affect global trade flows and the status of the US dollar as the main reserve currency.

nce961239cd.headline: Feds, state commit $1.26 billion to Michigan Potash, but some remain concerned about mine
nce961239cd.summary: Federal and state governments have committed $1.26 billion to the Michigan Potash project in Osceola County. Some residents remain concerned about the mine, which would produce potassium chloride.
nce961239cd.why: Potash is a key fertilizer mineral used by farmers to grow crops, and potassium chloride supply affects agricultural input costs. Mine financing shapes whether new domestic supply comes on line.

n46a7b353c8.headline: Union Budget 2025: ‘Challenge of pump priming economy to foster growth while maintaining fiscal consolidation’
n46a7b353c8.summary: Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman faces a difficult budget as an inflation-hit middle class cuts back on spending, with pressure to pump-prime growth while consolidating finances.
n46a7b353c8.why: India's Union Budget sets federal spending and tax policy, shaping growth, deficit targets and sector outlooks for investors.
